test_beta_python_plugin: test the gRPC Python protoc plugin by running the PythonPluginTest unittest suite
run_Protoc_plugin_tests: run all protoc plugin tests including unary, streaming, and duplex call scenarios

test_FullDuplexCall: test the FullDuplexCall bidirectional streaming with cancel, expire, and failure cases
